title: Affine etale section cocone is a colimit
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, c a limit cone, i₀ a stage, G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀), and W₀ an affine etale object over D(i₀) with quasi-compact and quasi-separated structure map. The canonical cocone of stage section sets [def-weil-pbc-affine-section-cocone] is a colimit cocone in Type (u+1). This asserts the universal property for all compatible maps out of the entire section diagram, not merely eventual equality of a specified pair.

proof.text: Obtain a representative of each limit section from the existing affine lifting theorem. Reverse its comparison equation to meet the surjectivity condition of Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf'.

Apply same-stage equality detection to the two representatives at a single stage. Oppose its arrow to obtain the later arrow in the section diagram. Apply Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' to the specified cocone, combining this equality condition with the preceding representatives.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YQ and 09YN, decomposition into representatives and same-stage equality; Mathlib Limits/Types/Filtered.lean:98 isColimitOf' combines them.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing canonical stage-section diagram or colimit theorem. ColimitSiteSections states evaluation commutes with filtered colimits of sheaves on one fixed site, rather than the varying-site section comparison needed here. ComparisonLaws supplies the concrete functor and cocone equations.

lean.statement: theorem etaleStageSectionCocone_isColimit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I) (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (W₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) [QuasiCompact W₀.hom] [QuasiSeparated W₀.hom] [IsAffine W₀.left] : Nonempty (IsColimit (etaleStageSectionCocone D c i₀ G W₀))
